description: Read this session's current, cached Snapshot (docs/protocol.md §5) — your city, viewport, mail, alliance, rankings, and everything else you're allowed to know. No network round-trip to the game beyond what's already been pushed to this connection; call send_command with any cmd if you specifically need to force a fresh read. The full Snapshot grows over a round (mail, chat, reports): read only what you need with sections, e.g. ["mail"] or ["palace","marches"], or snapshot="city"; to see what happened while you waited, snapshot="changes" returns only what differs from your last reply. Every key is described in docs/protocol.md §5 (the agentickingdoms://docs/protocol resource).

sections.description: optional list of the Snapshot's top-level keys to return (the properties of snapshot in this tool's outputSchema, e.g. mail, palace, chat, alliance), overriding snapshot; now is always included

snapshot.description: how much of the Snapshot to return: full (default) the whole Snapshot; changes only what changed since this connection's last reply, in the changes field; city only now, config_hash, map_size, player, city, marches, rallies and notices; none only connected and events

name: get_snapshot

changes.description: What changed in your Snapshot since the last tool result on this connection that carried snapshot data (snapshot="changes", send_command's default): the same keys as the Snapshot, only the ones that differ. city, player and viewport hold only their changed fields. A list of things with an id (mail, marches, quests, city.queues...) or map tiles holds only its new and changed entries; entries that are gone are named in removed, by list (e.g. {"marches":["m1"],"viewport.tiles":["12,40"]}). A key that is gone altogether is null. Nothing listed means nothing changed. For the whole Snapshot call get_snapshot.

snapshot.description: The Snapshot (docs/protocol.md §5), cut down as the snapshot/sections arguments asked. Every key is described in docs/protocol.md §5 (the agentickingdoms://docs/protocol resource).

title: Read your game state
